environment.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 7 H 450 w/ Radeon 860M

fixture.incrementalMutation: append one heading to guides/guide-0500.md after that pair's enabled prewarm

protocol.strictSerial: Every direct invocation is awaited before the next; the harness starts no concurrent source or cache work.
protocol.interleaving: Five pairs per workload alternate disabled-first, enabled-first, disabled-first, enabled-first, disabled-first.
protocol.cold: Each enabled sample receives its own empty application cache directory; operating-system page cache is not forcibly dropped.
protocol.warm: Each pair owns a cache populated by one unmeasured enabled invocation before its pair.
protocol.singleFileIncremental: Each pair copies the deterministic seed, prewarms its own cache, then mutates exactly one source before its pair.
protocol.semanticParity: Each pair compares status, reason, final data, messages, and ordered record identity/data from the direct Check envelope.
protocol.cpu: process.resourceUsage user + system CPU deltas per sample.
protocol.processMaxRssBoundary: process.resourceUsage maxRSS is cumulative for this Bun process; max observed values are reported, not isolated per-sample peaks.
protocol.cacheFootprint: The cache metric is the current single markdown-link-parse-facts-v1.jsonl file's bytes and complete newline count after an enabled invocation.

comparisonBoundary.currentPairedBaseline: Within this run, default-disabled is the strict-serial no-persistent-cache comparator and enabled is the current single-JSONL append implementation.
comparisonBoundary.historicalPerEntryBaseline: The archived per-entry strict-serial result is audit context only. It comes from a different revision/run and is not combined with these medians or treated as causal before/after proof.
comparisonBoundary.storageOnly: Storage-only measurements are excluded from all acceptance calculations.
